title: Budget Vegan Day: Breakfast, Lunch, and Dinner Recipes Across Three Budgets (Goodful)

locations.name: Los Angeles, California (LA)
locations.basis: explicit in transcript 'in la' used for restaurant-price context; location inferred for regional pricing example

summary: Goodful features three vegan cooks (Rachel, Will, and May) preparing breakfast, lunch, and dinner across different budget levels, illustrating practical, affordable plant-based cooking. The video lays out multiple recipes and budget-friendly techniques, including baking banana oatmeal, a chickpea flour/ aquafaba scramble, a smoothie bowl, zucchini lentil fritters with a tofu-based vegan sour cream, a BLT with vegan bacon, a Just Egg omelette, Nashville hot mushroom sandwiches, and a chili mac with Beyond Beef, TVP, and Miyoko’s cheese. Interwoven are cost-saving strategies (bulk buying, end-of-day market discounts, using dried beans and homemade condiments) and notes on pricing versus eating out, providing a roadmap for budget-conscious vegan meal planning across a full day.

Green smoothie bowl with frozen fruit, yogurt, spirulina
Just Egg omelette with veggies and Miyoko's cheddar
Nashville hot mushroom sandwich (marinade, batter, fry)
Bonza chickpea pasta (protein-focused pasta) in chili mac
Beyond Beef and TVP as budget-friendly fillings
Dried beans vs canned beans for budget meals
End-of-day farmers market discounts as a saving tactic
Budget storytelling about LA restaurant-price contrasts
Aquafaba as binder and marinade component
Budget vs value: homemade vs store-bought condiments
Lentils, oats, and beans as core pantry staples

sections.title: Budget-setting intro and banana oatmeal (May)
concepts: Oats, spices, and fruit as affordable breakfast
sections.description: Intro segment introduces three cooks and their budgets. May demonstrates baked banana oatmeal: mashing bananas, adding oats, salt, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg, flax eggs, maple syrup, coconut oil, vanilla, and non-dairy milk; bakes in loaf pans at 350°F for ~35 minutes; she also makes a homemade sunflower seed butter from bulk roasted seeds blended with maple, sunflower oil, and salt.

sections.title: Vegan Chickpea Scramble (May)
concepts: Nutritional yeast, turmeric, cumin, chili powder
sections.description: Chickpea scramble: mix chickpea flour with water and aquafaba, season with nutritional yeast, turmeric, cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper; sauté onions, garlic, and peppers in coconut oil; add mixture and cook with stirring until texture forms; ends with parsley and optional extra vegetables.

sections.title: Green Smoothie Bowl (May)
concepts: Toppings: hemp seeds, chia seeds, granola, almond butter
sections.description: May prepares a green smoothie bowl using frozen bananas, blueberries, coconut yogurt, vanilla almond butter, kale, spirulina, and almond milk, topped with berries, hemp and chia seeds, gluten-free granola, and extra almond butter; notes on cost of superfood powders.

sections.title: Lunch: Zucchini & Red Lentil Fritters with Vegan Sour Cream
concepts: Red lentils and all-purpose flour batter
Seasonings: garlic powder, smoked paprika, cayenne
sections.description: May shows zucchini-lentil fritters: grate zucchini, remove excess moisture, mix with red lentils, flour, salt, garlic powder, paprika, and cayenne; form patties and fry until crispy. Vegan sour cream is made from soft tofu blended with lemon juice, oil, and salt.

sections.title: Lunch: Benevolent Bacon BLT with Arugula
concepts: Cast iron skillet browning vegan bacon
sections.description: A BLT-style sandwich using Benevolent Bacon, arugula instead of lettuce, bread with vegan mayo, and garden tomatoes; skillet-browned bacon and notes on cost relative to eating out.

sections.title: Lunch: Just Egg Vegan Omelette
concepts: Just Egg liquid for an omelette
Sautéed broccoli and peppers, Field Roast sausages
sections.description: A Just Egg omelette prepared with broccoli, peppers, and Field Roast sausage; finished with Miyoko’s cheddar; served with avocado toast; discussion on price vs traditional eggs.

sections.title: Dinner: Nashville Hot Mushroom Sandwich (Marinade + Fry)
concepts: Vegan marinade with almond milk, pickle brine, hot sauce, aquafaba
Cast iron cooking with butter and coconut oil
Cayenne, garlic powder, pink salt, black pepper, brown sugar
Toasted bun with pickles and hot sauce
sections.description: The Nashville hot-style sandwich uses a lemony almond-milk marinade with pickle brine and aquafaba; mushrooms are marinated, coated in seasoned flour, fried twice and air-dried, then tossed in a cayenne-spiked butter-coconut oil sauce, finished with agave and pickles.

sections.title: Dinner: Chili Mac with Beyond Beef, TVP, and Miyoko’s Cheese
sections.description: Chili mac prep with cornstarch, chili powder, oregano, paprika, and salt; pasta (Bonza) cooked with broccoli; Beyond Beef is browned, then thickened with stock and almond milk; rehydrated TVP for texture; finished with Miyoko’s cheddar that melts well; notes on cost and value.

sections.title: Closing and Takeaways
sections.description: Final music cue and reflection on affordable vegan cooking, reiterating that many flavorful meals can be made at home cheaper than dining out.
